description: How an approval link from request_trade stands: { id, url, state, expiresAt, side, amount, slippageBps, coin, wallet, signature, out }. state: open (waiting for the person), sent (they approved and the trade is on its way to Solana), confirmed (it landed: signature is the transaction, wallet the one that traded), failed (it landed and failed on chain), dropped (the network dropped it, so it never landed), declined (they declined it), expired (an hour passed with no approval) or stopped (the approval stopped partway, so Souvenir can't tell whether the trade went out: the person should check their wallet before asking for a new link). A link that ended never comes back: ask for a new one. wallet and out are given once the trade was sent; out is what the trade was built to give (coins for a buy, lamports for a sell); the exact amount is on chain under signature. Read it every few seconds while it is open or sent.
name: trade_request
title: Read an approval link
